policy: One combined TASM1/2 Red kit; Overclock, Dragnet and Vortex are its final added skills. Cape-free 2099 appearance, Hunter's Return and Talon Lift are published. The remaining five Black replacements and expanded air/physical-counter mechanics are design proposals only. Preserve native controls, ownership/dependencies, Both Suits traversal and rewards. Prices, third suit, shop/save expansion and branches remain deferred.

suits.kit: Proposed physical scrapper loop: meet the attack, counter/catch, choose grounded pressure or manual launch/jump, contact-gated air pressure and spike/slam/re-engage. Hunter's Return and Talon Lift are implemented. The remaining five purchased replacements, including their proposed air branches, and Talon Guard remain unimplemented; use the live roadmap for the working controls, ownership and counter alternative.

latest_feedback.summary: Flesh out the full kit and how it plays, add air combos, and explore blocking or instant counterattacks because 2099 should be a scrapper. No new appearance or gameplay feel verdict is recorded.
